good_thing: (Kazakhstan): Two female Przewalski’s horses born and raised at Marwell Zoo have returned to their native range in Kazakhstan. Shara and Togs are part of an international effort to rebuild wild populations of a species declared Extinct in the Wild in 1969. A long trip home, and a hopeful pair of hoofprints.
current_or_history: On September 1, 1773, Phillis Wheatley’s *Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral* was published in London. The Library of Congress calls it the first volume of poetry by an African-American poet to be published. Wheatley was about 20.
tiny_fact: Deep-sea sea cucumbers in the genus *Enypniastes* are commonly called “headless chicken monsters.” While most sea cucumbers crawl along the seafloor, these use fin-like flaps to swim long distances.
thought: You do not have to solve the whole horizon today; one steady step still counts.
